title: MemorySubjectsEnsureResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "subject_id": string, "created": bool, "status": string, "revision": int }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.subjects.ensure (§7.5): SPACE_FROZEN, SUBJECT_FENCED, NOT_AUTHORIZED, INVALID_INPUT. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
